leaves.label: Existentialist Film
leaves.defn: An art-film character study whose engine is a crisis of meaning — alienation, ennui, a life weighed up or a self disguised (La Dolce Vita, The Silence, Lost in Translation, The Passenger, Citizen Kane). A clinical inner state goes to A16-7; a quiet everyday portrait to A16-9.
leaves.axis: by the shape of the crisis: modernist alienation, the ennui of the affluent, double lives and masks, rise-and-fall lives, then midlife and old age

leaves.axis: by the social ill: addictions first (drink, drugs, gambling), then race and caste, youth violence, sexual violence and reproductive rights, the oppression of women, and sex work last

leaves.axis: by the sacrifice at the core: maternal sacrifice first, then the woman's film of the fallen or desiring woman, the family melodrama, and the illness tearjerker last
